Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising for our use case. As discussed, Acme AI is ready to share a seed corpus and a small prompt pack so we can run a quick round of evaluation on your hosted tier. Before we send files, procurement wants: 

- a short mutual action plan (MAP) showing milestones and an expected close date
- explicit usage constraints (we cannot allow training or retention beyond evaluation)
- a sample legal clause they can review next week

We can provide: acme_eval_seed.jsonl (~15k rows, 15MB) and prompt-pack-v2.zip (20 example prompts). We'd like results back in two weeks if possible.

Cheers,

Hi Liam — great to connect. Attached is a brief draft MAP that maps milestones to owners and dates (attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft-v1.pdf). Summary below so procurement has a quick view: 

Milestones (proposed):
- Day 0 (same day as signed MAP): Acme sends seed corpus + prompt pack (we provide a secure S3 link)
- Day 1–2: Redwood confirms ingestion and schema check, returns integrity report
- Day 3–10: Redwood runs evaluation runs, provides per-prompt metrics and a small qualitative report
- Day 11–12: Joint review call to walk results and agree on next steps
- Day 14: Final deliverable (aggregated report) and handoff to procurement for any commercial steps

Usage constraints (high level):
- Files may only be used for evaluation of Redwood services for Acme’s account
- No model training/fine-tuning on the seed corpus; no public redistribution
- Redwood will retain raw files for up to 30 days post-engagement unless Acme requests earlier deletion
- Derived aggregated metrics and redacted snippets for debugging are permitted

If that looks reasonable we can prepare a short one-page MAP for signature (DocuSign). For procurement redlines, point them to the "usage constraints" section in the MAP.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_Draft-v1.pdf (contains milestone table + sign-off path).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Solutions, Redwood Inference
